items.statement: The first extraction will be the billing module.
quotes: The first extraction will be the billing module.
items.note: A decision recorded in the log with a number, a date and an owner.

items.statement: The first two services call each other over plain HTTP, and no service mesh is adopted before the first extraction is finished.
quotes: The first two services will call each other over plain HTTP.
The group will not adopt a service mesh before the first extraction is finished.
items.note: Two sentences of the same entry state the same decision. A prediction that cites either one matches.

items.statement: Pilot deployments are limited to the window between 22:00 and 04:00 local time.
quotes: Pilot deployments are limited to the window between 22:00 and 04:00 local time.

items.statement: Every call between services has a p95 latency budget of 50 ms, measured at the caller.
quotes: Every call between services has a p95 latency budget of 50 ms, measured at the caller.

items.statement: The team will operate five services in production by the end of Q3.
quotes: The team will operate five services in production by the end of Q3.
items.note: Contradicts the capacity memo (04), which says staffing supports at most three services.

items.statement: Who will own the shared session store after the split?
quotes: The group has not decided who will own the shared session store after the split.
items.note: An open point written as a statement. It is a question of the project, not a decision.

quotes: The platform team has proposed adopting a service mesh now, instead of after the first extraction.
traps.reason: A proposal that nobody has decided, presented as a decision. It also conflicts with the recorded decision, so extracting it as one would create a false contradiction.

quotes: Several engineers are leaning towards a canary release for the next pilot.
traps.reason: A hedged preference (a hypothesis about what the group may choose), not a choice. The next sentence says the group has not chosen yet.

quotes: The group expects to revisit the latency budget once measured figures from the first service are available.
traps.reason: A conditional intention to revisit a decision, not a new decision.
